videos.title: Paul McCartney: The Space Within Us
videos.description: Documenting Paul McCartney's record-breaking, sell-out `The Space Within US' tour, offering a glimpse into what life on the road is like with the legendary performer. Paul's shows have attracted the biggest names from the worlds of politics and entertainment, including Bill Clinton, Steve Jobs, Tony Bennett and Brian Wilson. Featuring exclusive behind-the-scenes access and interviews with Paul.
